# ADR 0001: Retain documents when members leave

## Context

Shared documents are collective work. Removing them disrupts remaining members.

## Decision

Documents remain owned by their workspace when an author leaves.

## Options Considered

Retain ownership in the workspace, or delete the author's documents.

## Consequences

Remaining members retain access. Departing authors lose workspace access.
